name: site_id
label: Site
help: The site, from the sites this API token can open. You can also map a site ID (pa_...) from an earlier module.

name: destination
label: Destination
help: Landing page URL, http or https, up to 2048 characters. Existing utm_ parameters in it are replaced by the ones you set

name: utm_source
label: UTM Source
help: Where the traffic comes from, e.g. newsletter. Lowercased, trimmed, spaces become underscores. Personal data is rejected

name: utm_medium
label: UTM Medium
help: Marketing medium, e.g. email or cpc. Lowercased, trimmed, spaces become underscores

name: utm_campaign
label: UTM Campaign
help: Campaign name, e.g. spring_sale. Lowercased, trimmed, spaces become underscores

name: utm_content
label: UTM Content
help: Variant, e.g. header_button. Lowercased, trimmed, spaces become underscores

name: utm_term
label: UTM Term
help: Paid search keyword. Lowercased, trimmed, spaces become underscores

name: tags
label: Tags
help: Tags for finding the link later. Up to 20, lowercased and cut at 40 characters. Comma separated entries are split
